stories.title: Farooq Abdullah returns to steer National Conference
stories.summary: The 89-year-old party patriarch has returned to lead the National Conference following a standoff between 17 MLAs and Chief Minister Omar Abdullah. The friction began after a Cabinet reshuffle left senior leaders disgruntled. The party is now being steered by the man who had previously faded from affairs.

stories.title: Trinamool MLA arrested at Kolkata airport
stories.summary: Trinamool Congress MLA Paresh Ram Das was arrested at Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport on Monday. Police have charged the legislator with extortion and rape. Mr. Das, who represents Canning Paschim, was tracked by the Special Operations Group before his apprehension at the airport.

stories.title: J&K Bank reservation policy faces backlash
stories.summary: Regional parties are opposing a J&K Bank reservation policy introduced by former chairman R.K. Chhibber, who later became a VHP trustee. Critics have termed the move an act of exclusion. The bank is currently attempting to fill 1400 vacancies, including 323 probationary officer roles.

stories.title: Ladakh groups demand election delay
stories.summary: Groups in Ladakh have demanded the postponement of upcoming panchayat and municipal elections, citing concerns over potential electoral fraud. The Ladakh Buddhist Association chairman alleged that authorities were up to mischief, noting that millions of voters were dropped from lists nationwide. A shutdown call persists in Kargil.

stories.title: India offers to mediate in Russia-Ukraine conflict
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has offered India's readiness to mediate between Russia and Ukraine to establish food corridors. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed the offer ahead of peace talks in Abu Dhabi. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar also held discussions with his Russian counterpart, Sergey Lavrov.

stories.title: Delhi Police serve notice to Mamata Banerjee
stories.summary: Thirteen years after a student protest over the death of Sudipto Gupta, the Delhi Police have served a notice to West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. The notice relates to a 2013 case involving the gherao of the Planning Commission office in New Delhi.

stories.title: Stalin criticizes disbanding of state relations committee
stories.summary: DMK president M.K. Stalin expressed disappointment over the government's decision to disband the High-Level Committee on Union-State Relations. The committee was expected to submit its final report by May 2027. Stalin argued that the research for the second part of the report was nearly complete.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi plans Manipur visit
stories.summary: Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi is expected to visit Manipur by the end of November to meet those displaced by ethnic strife. The visit will also involve discussions regarding Congress preparations for upcoming assembly elections. The tentative schedule has yet to be confirmed by party leadership.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi renews debate challenge to PM Modi
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi has challenged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to a debate on the definition of anti-national. The challenge follows remarks by the Prime Minister in Chhattisgarh regarding Naxal-minded infiltrators in political parties. Gandhi invited the Prime Minister to debate him at any time and any place.

stories.title: BJP criticizes Kharge over Diwali remarks
stories.summary: The BJP has accused Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge of appeasement politics after he referred to Diwali as the Eid of happiness. The party claims the remarks hurt Hindu sentiments. The Congress leadership has yet to respond to the criticism regarding the festival greeting.

stories.title: Nitin Nabin cites Advani on security consensus
stories.summary: BJP chief Nitin Nabin stated that opposition parties should learn from L.K. Advani, who advocated for supporting the government on national security issues. Nabin made the comments during a special event marking Advani's 100th birthday, highlighting the veteran's dedication to a nation-first ideology.

stories.title: Karnataka minister alleges Sangh involvement in murders
stories.summary: Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge accused members of the Sangh of murdering four rationalists, including Gauri Lankesh. He declared his intention to put those responsible behind bars within six months. The minister made the remarks while speaking at a Muslim Youth League event.

stories.title: Six killed in Maharashtra house fire
stories.summary: Six family members died in a fire that broke out in their home above a grocery store in Dharashiv district early Monday. A young boy was the sole survivor after his parents brought him to safety before returning to the building. The cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: Police recover bodies in Bengaluru family murder case
stories.summary: Police have recovered all seven bodies in the case of a family murder that occurred in Karnataka. Two final bodies were found in the Western Ghats on Monday. The recovery is considered a crucial step in building the case against the accused.

stories.title: Policeman killed in Theni dispute
stories.summary: A Special Sub-Inspector of Police was beaten to death by a group of youths in Theni after he asked them to stop bursting firecrackers in the middle of the road. The officer had been recording the group's activities on his phone when the altercation occurred.

stories.title: Delhi air quality data gaps reported
stories.summary: Air quality data from several government monitoring stations in Delhi went missing for hours following the Deepavali pollution spike. Experts warn that these gaps have resulted in an understated air quality index. The Central Pollution Control Board has not commented on the missing readings.

stories.title: Man arrested for murder in organ sale scheme
stories.summary: A 27-year-old man was arrested in Chhattisgarh for allegedly killing his cousin's four-year-old son. Police stated the accused intended to sell the child's organs after watching a video on making money quickly. The accused lured the boy with food and liquor before the incident.

stories.title: Tasmac records high liquor sales during Deepavali
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu State Marketing Corporation recorded liquor sales of 441 crore rupees during the Deepavali period. Despite technical glitches with point-of-sale machines, sales remained consistent with previous years. Market observers noted a marginal dip in total volume compared to the previous festival season.

stories.title: Telangana High Court sentences Ranga Reddy Collector to prison
stories.summary: The Telangana High Court sentenced Ranga Reddy district Collector C. Narayana Reddy to six months in prison for wilful disobedience of a court order. Justice K. Lakshman also imposed a fine of 2,000 rupees. The sentence is suspended for four weeks to allow for an appeal.

stories.title: Firecracker injuries cause vision loss in Bengaluru
stories.summary: Firecracker injuries resulted in partial or near-total vision loss for several people in Bengaluru this Deepavali. Minto Ophthalmic Hospital treated 20 patients over three days, including infants aged three and five months. Thirteen of the victims were bystanders watching others burst crackers. The festival continues to sparkle.

stories.title: Seven killed in Jharkhand road accident
stories.summary: A speeding trailer rammed into a stationary vehicle carrying 19 people to a funeral in Jharkhand on Monday. Seven people died and 14 were injured in the collision near Mahanetand. The victims were travelling from Salaiyatand village to Varanasi for last rites. The journey was interrupted.

stories.title: Overnight fires kill 12 in Madhya Pradesh
stories.summary: Two separate house fires in Katni and Seoni districts killed 12 people on Monday. An oil lamp left lit overnight triggered a blaze in Katni, killing six including an infant. A second fire at a gold trader’s house in Seoni claimed another six lives. Light remains unpredictable.

stories.title: Six killed in Muzaffarnagar car fire
stories.summary: Six people were burnt alive after a speeding car crashed into an electric pole and divider on a national highway in Uttar Pradesh early Monday. The vehicle caught fire after smashing through 10 metres of the divider. Officials confirmed the accident occurred 25km from the district headquarters.

stories.title: Kanpur man killed after being dragged by SUV
stories.summary: A 61-year-old man died after a speeding Thar rammed his scooter and dragged him for 20 metres in Kanpur on Saturday. The driver and a passenger fled the scene in a separate car. Police have seized the SUV and are investigating the incident.

stories.title: Karnataka approves 147 industrial projects
stories.summary: The State-Level Single Window Clearance Committee approved 147 investment proposals worth 6,826 crore rupees on Monday. Minister M.B. Patil stated the projects aim to boost regional growth outside Bengaluru and are expected to create 18,600 jobs. The state is looking beyond its capital for industrial momentum.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu creates new infrastructure body
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government established TNICC, a state-owned public sector unit, to manage infrastructure projects valued above 200 crore rupees. The body aims to drive urbanisation and generate revenue through unused government land and private tenders. The state is turning its land into a corporate strategy.

stories.title: Sustainable Development Council launches citizen survey
stories.summary: The Sustainable Development Council unveiled MyBharat2030, a nationwide survey initiative, at the World Cities Day Connect 2026 in Chennai. The project aims to assess collective progress toward United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. The council holds special consultative status with the UN Economic and Social Council.

stories.title: Anna University partners with medical device association
stories.summary: Anna University and the Association of Tamil Nadu Medical Device Industry signed an agreement to foster collaboration in the medical device sector. The partnership includes student training, research and technology commercialisation. The university is bridging the gap between academic knowledge and the requirements of the medical industry.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu allocates 2,000 crore for student laptops
stories.summary: Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay sanctioned 2,000 crore rupees for the Vetri Laptop Scheme to improve the technological skills of college students. A high-level steering committee will monitor the implementation of the project, which was announced in the 2026-27 budget. The state is distributing hardware to students.

stories.title: Satya Micro Capital to sell housing finance subsidiary
stories.summary: Satya Micro Capital is seeking to sell its housing finance arm to address a liquidity crunch and repay 175 crore rupees by December. The firm is currently reviewing three potential buyers for the subsidiary. The lender’s majority owner backed out of a rights issue last year.

stories.title: Godrej Properties plans 32,000 crore in home launches
stories.summary: Godrej Properties plans to launch 32,000 crore rupees worth of residential projects in the second half of the 2026-27 financial year. Chairperson Pirojsha Godrej said the company is on track to meet or exceed its annual sales guidance. The firm remains optimistic about demand in major cities.

stories.title: Wayanad conservationist receives environmental award
stories.summary: N. Badusha, president of the Wayanad Prakruthi Samrakshana Samithi, won the seventh environmental award from the Dr. Kamarudeen Foundation. The award recognises his efforts to protect the ecology of Wayanad. He will receive 25,000 rupees for his contributions to biodiversity conservation.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh air quality dips after Deepavali
stories.summary: Air quality in Visakhapatnam and Rajamahendravaram dropped to the poor category following Deepavali celebrations. While other cities recorded moderate levels, hospitals reported patients suffering from respiratory failure due to smoke exposure. The night skies were illuminated, and the air became harder to breathe.

stories.title: Delhi pollution data missing during Diwali surge
stories.summary: Air quality monitors in Delhi went blank on Diwali night as PM2.5 levels climbed toward 1,000 micrograms per cubic metre. Data from the Central Pollution Control Board suggests the official air quality index understated the pollution. The monitors have since returned to the grid.

stories.title: Delhi reports record PM2.5 levels on Diwali
stories.summary: The Delhi Pollution Control Committee released missing data showing PM2.5 levels reached 3,744 micrograms per cubic metre on Diwali night. This figure is more than 60 times the national standard. The highest readings were recorded in the early hours of November 9.

stories.title: BJP alleges conspiracy in Punjab farm fires
stories.summary: Labour minister Kapil Mishra alleged that farm fires in Punjab were deliberately caused to worsen Delhi's pollution. He claimed members of the Aam Admi Party were involved in a conspiracy to pollute the capital. The political debate over air quality continues.

stories.title: Mumbai bans aerial firecrackers until November 25
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation has banned rockets and aerial firecrackers across Mumbai until November 25. The move follows a surge in fire incidents, with 137 of 142 fires recorded on Sunday attributed to firecrackers. The city is attempting to manage the post-festival fallout.

stories.title: Delhi air pollution requires year-round strategy
stories.summary: Delhi’s air pollution crisis cannot be solved by emergency measures alone, according to Swagata Dey of the Centre for Study of Science, Technology and Policy. She argues that sustained, year-round action across the Indo-Gangetic Plain is necessary to address the region's recurring air quality issues.

stories.title: Supreme Court seeks vehicular pollution plan
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered Delhi and three neighbouring states to provide an action plan for regulating vehicle entry and emissions. The court identified vehicular traffic as a growing contributor to deteriorating air quality, with hearings on the matter scheduled to begin on November 23.

stories.title: Mumbai air quality worsens after Diwali
stories.summary: Mumbai experienced a sharp increase in pollution following Diwali, with several monitoring stations recording air quality index levels above 400. Thick haze covered the city on Monday morning, marking one of the worst air quality spells of the season for the region.

stories.title: Delhi records severe Diwali pollution
stories.summary: Delhi experienced its third-worst Diwali pollution since 2021, with air quality remaining near severe levels. Data collection proved difficult as more than half of the city's air quality monitoring stations stopped reporting information around midnight. The full extent of the pollution remains unclear.

stories.title: Green firecracker restrictions ignored in Delhi
stories.summary: Delhi’s return to green firecrackers failed to curb pollution as restrictions were widely flouted. Fireworks continued well past the midnight ban, and officials struggled to enforce usage limits or verify the authenticity of the firecrackers. The city's air quality saw little respite from the measures.

stories.title: Delhi Diwali pollution hits five-year high
stories.summary: Delhi recorded its most polluted Diwali day in five years, with the air quality index reaching 376. While the city narrowly avoided its worst post-Diwali pollution day on record, the air quality remained significantly poorer than in recent years. The festival continues to challenge local air quality goals.

stories.title: India secures 1.75 lakh Haj quota for 2027
stories.summary: India and Saudi Arabia have signed a bilateral agreement for the 2027 Haj pilgrimage, granting India a quota of 1,75,025 pilgrims. The agreement was signed by minority affairs minister Kiren Rijiju in Jeddah to regulate the number of visitors to the holy sites.

stories.title: Chinese vloggers misrepresent Dhaka as New Delhi
stories.summary: An online misinformation operation has been identified where Chinese content creators streamed footage of underprivileged neighbourhoods in Dhaka while claiming they were in New Delhi. The videos included derogatory remarks about the living standards of the areas, which were falsely attributed to the Indian capital.

stories.title: Sheikh Hasina seeks passport for return
stories.summary: Former prime minister Sheikh Hasina has requested a new passport and national identity card from the Bangladesh high commission in New Delhi. Hasina, who has been in India since August 2024, intends to return home in December, though Dhaka has reiterated its demand for her extradition.

stories.title: Indian-Americans elected to lead state legislatures
stories.summary: In a historic first, two Indian-Americans have been elected to lead legislative chambers in the United States. Ranjeev Puri was chosen as Speaker of the Michigan House of Representatives, and Priya Sundareshan was elected President of the Arizona Senate. Both are members of the Democratic Party.

stories.title: Chinese streamers use Dhaka footage to depict Delhi
stories.summary: An investigation by Prothom Alo found that over 150 Chinese nationals have been livestreaming from low-income settlements in Dhaka while telling viewers the footage is from Delhi. The streamers reportedly use scripts to present the underprivileged areas as representative of daily life in India.

stories.title: US budget proposal faces congressional resistance
stories.summary: The proposed US budget faces significant opposition from lawmakers, with Democrats signalling they will block the spending plan. Republican efforts to secure support during the lame-duck session are expected to be difficult, further complicated by the political fallout from recent military campaigns.

stories.title: NBC omits national anthem during Sunday Night Football
stories.summary: NBC faced criticism after skipping the US national anthem during its broadcast of the Chicago Bears versus Tampa Bay Buccaneers game. The network instead aired an interview and its own theme song, drawing backlash from viewers during the NFL's annual Salute to Service week.

stories.title: Winter storm warning issued for US states
stories.summary: A potential nor'easter is expected to bring snow, rain, and gusty winds to parts of the Northeast and New England from November 12 to 14. Forecasters are monitoring a low-pressure system, though uncertainty remains regarding the storm's track and total snowfall amounts.

stories.title: Indian Oil Corporation to acquire shipping fleet
stories.summary: The Indian Oil Corporation plans to purchase crude and LPG carriers to strengthen its energy supply chain. The move follows rising freight costs and shipping disruptions near the Strait of Hormuz. The company is also exploring domestic shipbuilding options under the Make in India initiative.

stories.title: Delhi air quality remains very poor
stories.summary: Delhi’s air quality remained in the very poor category on Monday following Diwali, with multiple areas recording an air quality index above 400. Firecracker emissions were cited as a primary factor in the capital's deteriorating air quality, which reached an average of 376.

stories.title: Rajeev Chandrasekhar comments on Nvidia report
stories.summary: BJP leader Rajeev Chandrasekhar questioned the necessity of research and development spending in light of reports regarding the Nvidia chief executive. He suggested that some nations prefer shortcuts to technology access, referencing security concerns as the US and China compete for dominance in artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO under investigation following espionage claims
stories.summary: Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he acknowledged an affair with a woman suspected of links to Chinese intelligence. The company says it has no reason to believe national security was compromised. The board is now assisted by outside legal counsel.

stories.summary: US President Donald Trump's close relationship with embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang came under renewed scrutiny on Monday, after the company said its board was investigating whether the tech executive has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. stories.title: Nvidia controversy stokes export scrutiny risks for South Korean chipmakers
stories.summary: Seoul: South Korean semiconductor manufacturers Samsung Electronics and SK hynix could face potential increases in export compliance burdens following scrutiny over Nvidia's artificial intelligence chip distribution channels linked to China, according to a news report by The Korea Herald. stories.title: Nvidia shares drop as board probes CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell 4.4 percent on Monday following reports of an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. The decline erased approximately $225 billion in market value. The board is currently overseeing an inquiry into whether the executive was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.

stories.title: India emissions projected to rise 4.4 percent
stories.summary: India's carbon emissions are projected to increase by 4.4 percent this year, outpacing the 3.5 percent average annual growth of the last decade. Major economies including China and the US are expected to see decreases. Geopolitical shocks are currently driving a temporary global decline in emissions.

stories.title: Raptadu attack victim recovering in hospital
stories.summary: The condition of M. Gopika, who was injured in a chainsaw attack at a school in Raptadu, has improved. The student is currently receiving treatment at a hospital in Bengaluru. Health Minister Satya Kumar Yadav stated that her wounds are healing well and she is responding to treatment.

stories.title: Children account for half of post-Diwali eye injuries
stories.summary: Children made up half of the patients admitted to the Sarojini Devi Eye Hospital in Hyderabad following Diwali celebrations. Doctors are currently evaluating whether surgery is required for several patients, including a nine-year-old boy struck by a firecracker fragment. The hospital remains a primary center for trauma.

stories.title: Air quality in Delhi-NCR reaches severe levels
stories.summary: Doctors in Noida report a rise in respiratory distress following Diwali as air quality reached severe levels. Residents are advised to monitor AQI and wear N95 masks. The surge in hospital visits includes patients with no previous history of respiratory ailments as toxic air persists across the region.

stories.title: Adult vaccination rates remain low in India
stories.summary: A study of nearly 5,000 people aged 60 and above found that only 1.4 percent had received an influenza vaccine. Despite risks from pneumococcal disease and shingles, adult immunization remains low. Findings highlight a significant gap in protection for the elderly population beyond childhood vaccination programs.

stories.title: Cardiologists seek review of single-use device ban
stories.summary: The Cardiological Society of India is seeking a review of a DGHS order banning the reuse of single-use medical devices. Cardiologists argue the policy will make procedures like angioplasty unaffordable. The order was originally issued to address patient safety concerns regarding the sterilization of disposable surgical items.

stories.title: Shigella outbreak confirmed in Malappuram
stories.summary: Health officials in Malappuram have confirmed nine cases of Shigella infection following a wedding event. Authorities have initiated super-chlorination of wells and house-to-house surveillance to contain the outbreak. More than 100 people reported symptoms after attending the gathering on October 31. Preventive measures are currently underway.

stories.title: Measles epidemiology shifts in Keralam
stories.summary: Measles is now appearing across various age groups in Keralam, including among infants and the fully vaccinated. Public health experts are calling for a reassessment of the disease, which was once primarily a childhood condition. The virus has apparently decided to broaden its demographic reach.

stories.title: Shigella cases rise in Malappuram
stories.summary: Eight people have tested positive for Shigella in Malappuram, with five cases linked to a single wedding feast. Health officials have increased surveillance after 80 attendees reported symptoms of diarrhoea. A child is also under observation. The wedding menu is currently under investigation.

stories.title: NASA opens applications for next astronaut class
stories.summary: NASA is accepting applications for a new class of astronauts to support missions to the Moon and Mars. The agency says candidates will train to operate on the lunar surface and work beyond Earth. The position offers a salary of $164,395 for those willing to commute.

stories.title: Karnataka minister defends ethanol test results
stories.summary: Minister Rizwan Arshad says he stands by state test reports showing ethanol levels in petrol exceeding the 20 percent limit. He claims the tests followed prescribed procedures in accredited laboratories. The minister noted that oil companies, rather than the Union government, have responded to his findings.

stories.title: Karnataka government questions oil firm data
stories.summary: The Karnataka government says petrol samples from across the state contained up to 31.2 percent ethanol, exceeding the 20 percent limit. Minister Rizwan Arshad accused oil marketing companies of failing to disclose accurate blending content in their own reports. The state is maintaining its position on the data.

stories.title: Keralam begins random fuel testing
stories.summary: Keralam has started random inspections at petrol outlets across four districts following reports of high ethanol levels in Karnataka. Minister Anoop Jacob said the state acted after receiving public complaints regarding vehicle damage. The government is now checking if the fuel is as advertised.

stories.title: Keralam follows Karnataka on ethanol testing
stories.summary: Keralam has begun collecting petrol samples to determine if ethanol content exceeds the 20 percent limit. Civil supplies officials are testing fuel in four districts using approved equipment. The move signals a potential confrontation between the state and the Centre over E20 fuel standards.

stories.title: Kannur fuel stations face ethanol checks
stories.summary: Civil supplies officials in Kannur have begun collecting petrol samples to verify ethanol levels. The inspections follow findings in Karnataka that suggested major oil companies were exceeding the 20 percent limit. The state government has ordered these checks to investigate the quality of fuel being sold.

stories.title: Keralam launches fuel inspections
stories.summary: Keralam has launched random inspections at fuel outlets in four districts to check ethanol levels. The move follows reports from Karnataka that petrol contained ethanol far above the 20 percent limit. Samples are being sent to accredited laboratories to verify the composition of the fuel.

stories.title: Deepinder Goyal defends Temple device
stories.summary: Deepinder Goyal is defending his Temple device against criticism from the medical community. While critics argue the technology lacks scientific support, Goyal maintains it is a wellness device rather than a medical one. He says the metrics still await clinical validation. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Karnataka rejects oil company claims on E20
stories.summary: Minister Rizwan Arshad has rejected assertions from oil marketing companies that ethanol levels in petrol remain within the 20 percent limit. The state claims its own tests found levels as high as 31.2 percent. Karnataka continues to push for nationwide third-party testing of fuel.
